npcs.name: Torunn
npcs.idle: My boy Eilif plays the fiddle. He plays it far too well.

npcs.name: Old Skald Hrafn
npcs.idle: Every tune worth playing was stolen from somewhere. Most of the best from water.

npcs.name: Seeress Alfdis
npcs.idle: I read futures. I couldn't read my own apprentice's heart.

npcs.name: Flayer Kolr
npcs.idle: Trolls, witches, gotawitches. I flay what needs flaying.

quests.title: The Nacken's Tune
quests.offer:
My son Eilif is eleven and plays the fiddle better than any skald in Gotar. He learned it in a summer. From the water, he says - from a man who sits on a stone in the black pool and plays, with his feet in the water.

Last night Eilif went back to pay for the lessons. Old [Hrafn] says the nacken's price is always a life. Will you [find Eilif]?

topics.Hrafn: Old Hrafn the skald, by the longhouse. He's heard every story twice.

quests.summary: Torunn's son learned to fiddle from the nacken in the black pool, and has gone back to pay for the lessons.

steps.goal: Ask Old Skald Hrafn about the nacken
steps.say: The nacken teaches the best tunes in the world. And there's always one tune at the end - the one that makes people dance till they drop, and drown in his pool. That's how he's paid. He'll be at the black pool in the south-west. Listen for the [fiddle].

steps.goal: Go to the black pool in the south-west
steps.text: Fiddle-music, faint and wild. The wind is dancing - you'd swear it.
The dancing winds blow apart into nothing. The music falters, then starts again, closer to the water.

steps.goal: Search the bank of the black pool
steps.text: Eilif's fiddle-case, open and empty. Small footprints lead right to the water's edge - and stop.

steps.goal: Face the nacken of the black pool
steps.text: The nacken sinks back into the pool, still fiddling, more slowly. On the bank, a small boy coughs up water.

stages.name: the Nacken of the Black Pool
stages.announce: A pale man rises from the pool, fiddle under his chin, and smiles. 'He came to pay. Don't be rude.'

boss.name: the Nacken of the Black Pool

stages.success: the Nacken of the Black Pool falls.

steps.say:
He was nice. He was really nice. He taught me everything. And then he played the last tune and I was dancing in the water and I couldn't stop.

I know it, now. The [tune]. I can still hear it.

steps.goal: Help Eilif decide about the tune
steps.say:
If I play it, people will dance. Kings would pay for that. I'd be the greatest fiddler in Midgard. But they'd dance till they dropped, if I didn't stop. And I don't know if I would.

Should I [burn the fiddle]? Then I'll forget the tune. And all the others. Or should I [keep it], and be careful forever?

options.say: ...Will you hold my hand while it burns? ...Thank you. It's gone. They're all gone. I can't remember a single one.
I'll be careful. I'll be so careful. I'll never play the last one. Never.

steps.say:
He burned it? His fiddle? He loved that fiddle more than he loves me.

He can't play a note now. He sat in the kitchen this morning and tried, on his father's old one, and he couldn't. He laughed. He actually laughed. Thank you.

He's home, and he's playing. Better than ever.

Last night at the hall, everybody danced and nobody wanted to stop. He stopped. He did. I saw his face when he did. I'll be watching him every night of my life.

quests.title: The Stolen Rune-Stave
quests.offer:
My apprentice Hild stole my rune-stave - the one with the old blood-runes, the ones I swore never to use - and went south to the gotawitches. To learn what I wouldn't teach her.

The seers' law is clear. A seer who takes the blood-runes is branded and cast out. Will you [find Hild]? Flayer [Kolr] has seen the gotawitches' runestone.

topics.Kolr: Flayer Kolr, by the stables. Rude, but he knows the south woods.

quests.summary: Seeress Alfdis's apprentice stole her rune-stave of forbidden blood-runes and went to the gotawitches.

steps.goal: Ask Flayer Kolr about the gotawitches
steps.say: The gotawitches? South, past the woods, at the old runestone. They've seithr orbs floating round it like fireflies - kill those first, or they'll blind you. Your seer's girl went down there two days ago. I didn't stop her. I'm a flayer, not a [nursemaid].

steps.goal: Go south to the gotawitches' woods
steps.text: Lights drift between the trees - orbs of seithr, humming. Beyond them, the runestone glows red.
Alfdis's stave, planted in the earth before the stone and hung with fresh blood. Hild's blood, by the size of the cut. The rite's begun.
The gotawitch falls, and the runestone's light goes out. A girl sits in the circle with her arms bleeding, crying.

stages.name: Gotawitch Svanhvit
stages.announce: A gotawitch with a face like a pretty skull steps out of the stone. 'The girl came to me. The blood's half-poured. You're interrupting.'

steps.say:
She wouldn't teach me. She said I wasn't ready. I wanted to SEE. I wanted to see the real threads, not the pretty ones.

I saw them. I wish I hadn't. Take me back. Let her [brand me]. I deserve it.

She's back. And she used them - I can see it in her eyes.

The law says brand and exile. The law was written by people like me, for girls like her. I could [keep the law]. Or I could [take the blame] - say I taught her, and be branded myself. I'm old. She isn't. Which? I need someone else to say it.

options.say: Then the law. I'll do it gently. I'll do it myself. She'll go to Myrkwood; I have friends there. Gods forgive me.
Yes. Yes. It was my stave and my teaching and my fault. I'll go. She'll take my seat. She'll be better than me. She'll have to be.

law.text: Take this. You saved her life, whatever comes.

blame.text: Take this. I won't need it where I'm going.
